'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Reid Smith DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal]]
* '''Username:''' 3MW0J8
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
